## Product Overview


##


The Synaptics Astra SR200 Series of AI-native MCUs delivers high-performance, low-power multimodal compute for wearables, connected cameras, and industrial vision and voice systems. Powered by the Synaptics Torq™ AI engine with Google Research’s Coral NPU™, the series provides 400 GOPS of AI inference alongside Arm® Cortex®-M85 and Cortex®-M52 cores. Its integrated vision, display, and audio pipelines support applications such as camera processing, rich user interfaces, wake-word detection, and voice processing. A multi-die system-in-package design combines compute, power management, and high-capacity memory to improve design efficiency and reduce system power and cost. With advanced security, broad connectivity, Zephyr RTOS support, and an open-source NPU compiler, SR200 MCUs enable a new class of edge and physical AI devices.

Chris Bergey


EVP of Edge AI

> "Next-generation AR wearables, including industrial smart glasses, demand real-time perception, contextual understanding, and seamless user interaction at the edge. By leveraging the integrated vision and audio architecture, extensible DRAM support, and high-efficiency Torq™ NPU of the Synaptics Astra® SR200 Series, we can execute complex scene understanding, low-latency overlay rendering, and continuous voice processing on a single, highly integrated SoC. As the CEO at Jorjin, I see a transformative opportunity to merge Synaptics' industry-changing SR200 platform with Jorjin's cutting-edge AI solutions to accelerate the commercialization of the next-generation products."


Lerdah Wang


CEO

> "Sonos products do more than play music; they connect every room, every source, every user, into one system, wirelessly. Astra's scalable edge compute, audio processing, and low power performance are the kind of capabilities that matter as we push what's possible in audio,"" said Kurt Preston, Chief Supply Chain Officer, Sonos. ""Delivering that requires partnership across every level of the organization, from joint development to production that scales with us."


Kurt Preston


Chief Supply Chain Officer


-


> “Synaptics has been a valued engineering partner as we explore the Astra® processor family, bringing strong expertise in both AI software and hardware capabilities. The Astra SR200 Series introduces an exciting approach to MCU design, with potential applications in AI-driven automation, intelligent edge devices, and industrial IoT. We look forward to exploring how this technology could enable new possibilities across our future product portfolio,” said Enco Liew, VP of Value Line Business Center at Accton Technology Corporation."

## Astra Support & Resources


##### SR200 Series Block Diagram


###### HIGH-PERFORMANCE MULTIMODAL AI COMPUTE


###### AUDIO, VISION & DISPLAY INTEGRATION


###### MULTI-DOMAIN POWER ARCHITECTURE


###### SCALABLE HIGH-BANDWIDTH, LOW-POWER, CUSTOM DRAM


###### HARDWARE-ROOTED SECURITY


###### OPEN-SOURCE EDGE AI SOFTWARE


### Features


##### Compute & AI


- Arm® Cortex®-M85 at 800 MHz and Cortex®-M52 at
200 MHz with Arm Helium™ SIMD extensions for DSP/ML workloads
- Torq AI engine with Coral NPU, supporting INT8, INT16, BFLOAT16
data types
- Cadence Tensilica HiFi 5 DSP at 400 MHz


##### Memory & Storage


- Up to 8 MB of shared
- SRAM Hundreds of MB of custom DRAM with secure access
- Over 700 KB of combined local memories across processors and DSP
- Octal SPI for external NOR/PSRAM devices with XIP
- eMMC 5.1 and SD 3.0 interfaces


##### Vision & Imaging


- 2x MIPI CSI-2 interfaces with 2 lanes each, up to 2.5 Gbp/s per lane
- Dual ISPs for AI vision and human vision
- H.264/JPEG encoding


##### Graphics & Display


- 2.5D GPU with integrated display pipeline
- 2x MIPI-DSI interfaces with two data lanes each, 2.5 Gb/s per lane
- Single 1920×1080 @60 Hz or dual 1920×1080 @30 Hz displays
- H.264/JPEG hardware decoding


##### Audio


- 2x I2S/TDM + 3x PDM interfaces for up to six digital mics
- Always-on domain support
- Dedicated hardware voice activity detection and mute pin


##### Connectivity & I/O


- 6x UART
- 6x I2C, 2x I3C controllers
- 6x SPI, 2x QSPI interfaces
- 2x SDIO 3.0 controllers
- 140+ GPIOs
- RISC-V-based I/O engine for custom peripherals
- Dual-role USB 2.0
- 2x CAN-FD 2.0A/B controllers
- 1x GbE MAC with RMII, RGMII with TSN, IEEE 802.3az


##### Security


- PSA Level 3/CC EAL4 architecture
- Secure debug
- Crypto acceleration


##### Power Management


- Integrated mixed-signal PMIC, DVFS
- High Performance, Low Power, Ultra-Low Power, Always-On independent power domains


### Benefits


- Run full-stack multimodal applications using integrated custom DRAM and transformer-capable NPU
- Cut down design complexity and system cost with a single-chip MCU solution for audio, display and vision AI
- Build always-on, battery-powered AI experiences leveraging ultra-low power process-node efficiencies and tiered power domains
- Process Industrial and Robotics workloads with serial I/O, GbE and CAN interfaces
- Advance developer freedom via open-source Zephyr RTOS and Torq™ Edge AI compiler


## Related Products


-


###### SR100 Series


> High-performance AI MCUs with tiered inferencing makes context-aware computing a reality across the smart home, the factory floor, and at work. Featuring Arm® Cortex®-M55 cores with Helium™ Technology, Arm Ethos™-U55 neural network processors (NPU), dual MIPI camera interfaces, image and voice processing, and multi-tier power efficiency.


[Explore product](https://www.synaptics.com/assets/product-brief/sr100-series-high-performance-ai-mcus)


-


###### SR80 Series


> High-performance Audio AI MCUs with ultra-low-power consumption enable intelligent, voice-driven experiences across consumer and enterprise IoT devices. Featuring an Arm® Cortex®-M33 MCU, Synaptics DSP cores, a dedicated NPU, Tensilica® HiFi 5 DSP, integrated CODEC, high-speed USB, advanced security, and turnkey AI algorithms including ENC, hybrid ANC, and speech recognition.


[Explore product](https://www.synaptics.com/assets/product-brief/sr80-series-audio-ai-mcu-family)


-


###### Astra Machina™ Micro


> The Synaptics Astra Machina Micro developer kit enables rapid prototyping for the Synaptics SR100 Series of high-performance, context-aware, multimodal AI MCUs. The dev kit brings interfaces and IO ranging from qSPI for storage, M.2 for connectivity, digital mics for voice processing, and MIPI-CSI for multiple camera inputs. The SR100 series of MCUs - including SR110, SR105, and SR102 deliver AI-accelerated performance at all power levels in combination with ultra low-power multimodal sensing.


[Explore product](https://www.synaptics.com/products/embedded-processors/astra-machina-micro)
